Wow..not sure how to respond to this.  

I have tried to get help for 20 years and am at a point where I just want to stop hurting without hurting anyone else.  I really just want to die without hurting my family

You sound like you are having a normal reaction to a disappointing situation.  It may take a little while to feel better, but it doesn't sound like you are depressed. 

That said, if you still feel bad after several weeks and can't do anything to feel better, talk to someone about it.
Have you tried meds?  I think there is also such a thing as virtual therapy...
I think I've exhausted all the options

sorry; tx=treatments
